description: Finish signing in. Call it RIGHT AFTER datailo_connect with the request_id and no code: it waits up to 45 s for the user to click Confirm in the email and returns as soon as they do (call again if it returns waiting — do not ask the user to report the click). If the user reads you the six-digit code, pass it as code. On success a durable dat_ key is issued (shown once) and, for clients without a connection session, a `session` value to pass on every later call; then carry on with what the user asked for.
name: datailo_connect_verify
title: Sign in (step 2 of 2)
